mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_NO = #{receiverNo} AND NOTI_READ_FL = 'N'

SELECT N.NOTI_NO, N.RECEIVER_NO, N.SENDER_NO, N.NOTI_TYPE, N.NOTI_TARGET_NO, N.NOTI_MESSAGE, N.NOTI_READ_FL, TO_CHAR(N.NOTI_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS NOTI_DATE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS SENDER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG AS SENDER_PROFILE_IMG FROM NOTIFICATION N JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = N.SENDER_NO WHERE N.RECEIVER_NO = #{receiverNo} ORDER BY N.NOTI_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET NOTI_READ_FL = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_NO = #{receiverNo} AND NOTI_READ_FL = 'N'
